assessments.reason: The patched builder removes RPM OpenPGP entirely. Remaining RSA is selected only by tauri-macos-sign 2.4.2 (crate SHA256 b2ad3a8236db04071cb4ec8ebebb05dfac392f83d2dbc1cde18afcb8f5af65a2) on macOS. Its sole direct RSA use is ephemeral self-signed certificate key generation, not the RSA decryption affected by the Marvin advisory. Linux/Windows builders do not compile that target dependency. Canonical builds additionally reject signing credentials; isolated updater signing uses Minisign Ed25519. Whole-lock scanning still reports and expires this exact advisory assessment; no upstream RSA patch is claimed.

GTK3/GLib 0.18 derive-tooling dependency; no vulnerability is asserted by this maintenance advisory. Retain ABI compatibility while tracking the complete upstream GTK/WebKit migration. The separate GLib unsoundness is actually backported, not ignored.
